# Minnesota Secretary of State

> The official portal for Minnesota voter registration, elections, and state government board and commission appointments.

sos.mn.gov provides essential civic services including online voter registration through MNVotes and a comprehensive directory of Minnesota government appointees. The site serves as a central resource for voter eligibility information, registration updates, and access to state boards and commissions.

## Key Topics

- voter registration
- MNVotes
- Minnesota elections
- online registration
- eligibility requirements
- board and commission members
- public appointments
- appointing authorities
- name updates
- member search
- Minnesota government
- registration forms
- demographic filters
- position database

## Voter Registration

- [Register to Vote or Update Your Registration - MNVotes](https://mnvotes.sos.mn.gov/VoterRegistration/index): Online voter registration and update service for Minnesota citizens, including eligibility verification and name change updates

## Government Boards & Commissions

- [Member Search/Index](https://commissionsandappointments.sos.mn.gov/Member): Searchable directory of Minnesota government board and commission members with demographic filters and position database
